name: Suzumiya Haruhi no Tsuisou
source:
This is a sequel to "The Disappearance of Haruhi Suzumiya" movie, an adaptation of the fourth installment of the popular Haruhi Suzumiya light novel series. This sequel, The Reminiscences of Haruhi Suzumiya, is a direct continuation of the film's ending, taking place in the parallel world where the SOS Brigade doesn't exist. However, this sequel is a video game, featuring an original story; it just happens to be tied in to the plot closer than most Haruhi games. 

[From [url=http://www.japanator.com/the-reminiscences-of-haruhi-suzumiya-continues-last-film-17741.phtml]Japanimator.com[/url]]
translation:
本作是电影《凉宫春日的消失》的续篇。该电影改编自人气轻小说《凉宫春日》系列第四卷。《凉宫春日的追忆》直接承接电影结局，发生在SOS团并不存在的平行世界。

不过，这部续作并非电影，而是一款拥有原创故事的电子游戏；只是与原作剧情的联系比大多数《凉宫春日》游戏更加紧密。

[译自 [url=http://www.japanator.com/the-reminiscences-of-haruhi-suzumiya-continues-last-film-17741.phtml]Japanator.com[/url]]
